title: Language And Terminology Sweep Across Remaining Plugin Apps
description: Extend the language/terminology mechanism (ViewState.locale/terminology, AppDefinition.terminologies, already fully implemented for puzzle 3d and CAD) to the remaining ~22 plugin app crates: puzzle 2d, puzzle 5d, forms, forms-module-procedural, dag, draw, flow, gis, imperative, layout, lowpoly, note, presentation, procedural (2d+3d), raster, reasoning-mindmap, s (home+studio), sequence, shooting, trinity (jack+rewrite), vcs, writer. For each: add a per-app Labels struct (native English/German only, no invented terminology unless a genuine entity/sub-entity noun pair analogous to puzzle3d's Object/Vortex or CAD's Object/Primitive exists), a *_labels(view_state) resolver, thread it through render/tools/window_measures/window_engagements and their helper functions, add tests, and verify with cargo check/test per crate. Run via the Workflow tool (multi-agent, one agent per app/crate) since the pattern is now well-established from puzzle3d and CAD.
summary:
Ran a 22-agent Workflow sweep extending the language/terminology mechanism (established by the prior puzzle-3d and CAD tickets) to every remaining plugin app crate: puzzle-2d, puzzle-5d, forms, forms-module-procedural, dag, draw, flow, gis, imperative, layout, lowpoly, note, presentation, procedural (2d+3d), raster, reasoning-mindmap, s (home+studio), sequence, shooting, trinity (jack+rewrite), vcs, writer. Each agent read the puzzle3d/CAD reference implementations, added a per-app `*Labels` struct (native English/German consts, one field per label) and a `*_labels(view_state)` resolver, threaded it through render/tools/window_measures/window_engagements and their helper functions, fixed all resulting call-site breaks including in each crate's own test module, added 2-4 new tests per app, and self-verified with `cargo check -p <crate> --lib` + a scoped `cargo test`.

Result: 22/22 apps compiled cleanly, 526 hardcoded English labels translated to German across the sweep (breakdown per app in the workflow journal). One app — puzzle 2d — additionally earned a "reuse" terminology variant, remapping its Node/Handle entity/sub-entity pair to Building components/Connection points, matching the exact analogy already established by puzzle3d's Object/Vortex and CAD's Object/Primitive; every other app determined no genuine domain-noun pair existed and correctly stayed language-only (no invented terminology). A final `cargo check --workspace --lib` across the whole repo after all 22 changes landed together came back with zero new errors.

One pre-existing, unrelated test failure was surfaced and independently verified (not fixed, out of scope): `puzzle-plugin`'s `d2::tests::renders_distinct_canvas_per_pane` fails on pane-camera zoom math (`overview should zoom past selection`) that has nothing to do with labels/i18n — confirmed via git diff that none of the touched camera-math functions were edited, and reproduced deterministically in isolation both by the implementing agent and independently by this session.

Combined with the prior two tickets (puzzle-3d terminology, CAD language+terminology), every registered plugin app in the platform now has at least native English/German language support, and the three apps with a genuine entity/sub-entity domain-noun pair (puzzle-3d, CAD, puzzle-2d) additionally have a "reuse" terminology option.
